# Panel comparison 

## Density comparison

### Tumor/Non-tumor 

```{r}
# IMC - ccRCC data only
sce_TU <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/tumor_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_TU_07.rds")

sce_T <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas_full/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_T_07.rds")

sce_MY <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_07.rds")
```


```{r}
# Adjust T cell panel tissue area to CP pipeline from Lasse
Tpanel_area <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/T_panel/tissue_area/Tcell_TissueSegmentation.csv")
Tpanel_area$sample_id <- str_remove(Tpanel_area$FileName_glass, "_Probabilities.tiff")
Tpanel_area$PID <- sce_T$PID[match(Tpanel_area$sample_id, sce_T$sample_id)]
Tpanel_area$tissue_area <- Tpanel_area$AreaShape_Area
Tpanel_area <- Tpanel_area %>% select(PID, sample_id, tissue_area) %>% filter(!is.na(PID))

Tpanel_area_1 <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/T_panel/tissue_area/Tcell_TissueSegmentation_missing.csv")
Tpanel_area_1$sample_id <- str_remove(Tpanel_area_1$FileName_glass, "_Probabilities.tiff")
Tpanel_area_1$PID <- sce_T$PID[match(Tpanel_area_1$sample_id, sce_T$sample_id)]
Tpanel_area_1$tissue_area <- Tpanel_area_1$AreaShape_Area
Tpanel_area_1 <- Tpanel_area_1 %>% select(PID, sample_id, tissue_area) %>% filter(!is.na(PID))

T_panel_area_full <- rbind(Tpanel_area, Tpanel_area_1)

# Full info
T_panel_area_full <- T_panel_area_full %>% group_by(sample_id) %>% mutate(tissue_area_sum = sum(tissue_area)) %>% select(PID, sample_id, tissue_area_sum) %>% unique()
T_panel_area_full <- T_panel_area_full %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(mean_tissue_area = mean(tissue_area_sum))

# Add to sce_T
sce_T$tissue_area <- T_panel_area_full$mean_tissue_area[match(sce_T$PID, T_panel_area_full$PID)] #Changes the tissue area of the original object
```



```{r}
# Myeloid
PID_analysis_cat <- colData(sce_MY) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(analysis_cat,PID) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
PID_area <- colData(sce_MY) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(tissue_area,PID) %>% unique() %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(mean_tissue_area = mean(tissue_area))
PID_analysis_cat$mean_tissue_area <- PID_area$mean_tissue_area[match(PID_analysis_cat$PID, PID_area$PID)]
MY_analysis_cat <- PID_analysis_cat %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(density_tumor_MY = Freq/(mean_tissue_area/1000000)) %>% filter(analysis_cat == "tumor") %>% select(PID, density_tumor_MY)

# Add others
## T cell
PID_analysis_cat <- colData(sce_T) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(analysis_cat,PID) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
PID_area <- colData(sce_T) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(tissue_area,PID) %>% unique() %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(mean_tissue_area = mean(tissue_area))
PID_analysis_cat$mean_tissue_area <- PID_area$mean_tissue_area[match(PID_analysis_cat$PID, PID_area$PID)]
T_analysis_cat <- PID_analysis_cat %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(density_tumor_T = Freq/(mean_tissue_area/1000000)) %>% filter(analysis_cat == "tumor") %>% select(PID, density_tumor_T)

## Tumor
PID_analysis_cat <- colData(sce_TU) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(analysis_cat,PID) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
PID_area <- colData(sce_TU) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(tissue_area,PID) %>% unique() %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(mean_tissue_area = mean(tissue_area))
PID_analysis_cat$mean_tissue_area <- PID_area$mean_tissue_area[match(PID_analysis_cat$PID, PID_area$PID)]
TU_analysis_cat <- PID_analysis_cat %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(density_tumor_TU = Freq/(mean_tissue_area/1000000)) %>% filter(analysis_cat == "tumor") %>% select(PID, density_tumor_TU)

MY_analysis_cat$density_tumor_T <- T_analysis_cat$density_tumor_T[match(MY_analysis_cat$PID, T_analysis_cat$PID)]
MY_analysis_cat$density_tumor_TU <- TU_analysis_cat$density_tumor_TU[match(MY_analysis_cat$PID, TU_analysis_cat$PID)]
MY_analysis_cat <- MY_analysis_cat[complete.cases(MY_analysis_cat),]
```

```{r}
# Cluster channel marker correlation (all markers - does not show distribution which is usually recommended)
cor_sce <- MY_analysis_cat %>% column_to_rownames("PID") %>% as.data.frame

pdf("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/figures/compare_panels/corr_tumor_panels.pdf", width = 7, height = 5)
corrplot(cor(cor_sce,method = "spearman"), method="color", col=brewer.pal(n=8, name="RdBu"),  
         type="upper", order="hclust",hclust.method = "ward.D2", 
         addCoef.col = "black", addCoefasPercent = F,# Add coefficient of correlation
         tl.col="black", tl.srt=40, #Text label color and rotation
         # Combine with significance
         #p.mat = , sig.level = 0.01, insig = "blank", 
         # hide correlation coefficient on the principal diagonal
         diag=F
)
dev.off()
```

```{r}
cor_test <- cor.test(x = MY_analysis_cat$density_tumor_MY, MY_analysis_cat$density_tumor_T, method = "spearman")

#cor_test <- cor.mtest(fraction_combined %>% select(fra_my, fra_T, fra_tu), method = "pearson")
cor_test

ggplot(MY_analysis_cat, aes(x = density_tumor_T, y = density_tumor_MY))+  
  geom_point(aes(color = PID),size = 3)+
  geom_smooth(method='lm', formula= y~x, se = TRUE, color = "black")+
  scale_color_manual(values=metadata(sce)$colors$PID)+
  guides(color = "none")+
  ylab("Tumor fraction (T cell)")+
  xlab("Tumor fraction (Myeloid)")+
  theme_classic()+
  ggtitle(paste("Spearman = ",round(cor_test$estimate, digits = 2)))
```


### General immune cell types

#### Per celltype 

```{r}
## Read in data
general_dens_combined <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/survival_pred/BlockForest/general_densities_allpanels.csv")

general_dens_combined <- general_dens_combined %>% filter(!celltype_combined_broad %in% c("Unknown_Other", "tumor"))

out_cor <- foreach(i = unique(general_dens_combined$celltype_combined_broad), .combine = "rbind")%do%{

cor_sce <- general_dens_combined %>% filter(celltype_combined_broad == i) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = 2,names_from = panel, values_from = density) %>% column_to_rownames("PID") %>% as.data.frame

cor_sce <- cor_sce[complete.cases(cor_sce),]

cor_out <- cor(cor_sce,method = "spearman")

cor_out[cor_out !=1] %>% as.numeric() %>% unique()

data.frame(immune_metacluster = i, 
           cor = cor_out[cor_out !=1] %>% as.numeric() %>% unique(), 
           category = "celltype")
}

# Add general density
general_dens_out <- general_dens_combined %>% group_by(celltype_combined_broad) %>% summarise(density = mean(density, na.rm = TRUE))

out_cor$density_general <- general_dens_out$density[match(out_cor$immune_metacluster, general_dens_out$celltype_combined_broad)]

pdf("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/figures/compare_panels/corr_immune_panels.pdf", width = 5, height = 5)
ggplot(out_cor, aes(x = reorder(immune_metacluster,-cor), y = cor))+  
  geom_point(aes(color = immune_metacluster, size = density_general))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = NA, alpha = 0.8)+
  scale_color_manual(values=metadata(sce)$colors$immune_metacluster)+
  ylab("SCC")+
  xlab("Per celltype")+
  theme_classic()+
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,1))+
  ggtitle(paste("Mean SCC = ",round(mean(out_cor$cor), digits = 3)))
dev.off()
```

#### Per patient

```{r}

PID_cor <- foreach(i = unique(general_dens_combined$PID), .combine = "rbind")%do%{

cor_sce <- general_dens_combined %>% filter(PID == i) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = 1, names_from = panel, values_from = density) %>% column_to_rownames("celltype_combined_broad") %>% as.data.frame

cor_sce <- cor_sce[complete.cases(cor_sce),]

cor_out <- cor(cor_sce,method = "spearman")

diag(cor_out) <- NA

data.frame(PID = i, 
           cor = cor_out[upper.tri(cor_out)] %>% as.numeric() %>% unique(), 
           category = "PID")
}

PID_cor_out <- PID_cor %>% group_by(PID) %>% summarize(cor_mean = mean(cor, na.rm = TRUE), category = "PID")
```


```{r}
pdf("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/figures/compare_panels/corr_immune_panels_perPID.pdf", width = 3, height = 5)
ggplot(PID_cor_out, aes(x = category, y = cor_mean))+  
  geom_point(aes(color = PID))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = NA, alpha = 0.8)+
  scale_color_manual(values=metadata(sce)$colors$PID)+
  guides(color = "none")+
  ylab("SCC")+
  xlab("Per PID")+
  theme_classic()+
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,1))+
  ggtitle(paste("Mean SCC = ",round(mean(PID_cor$cor, na.rm = TRUE), digits = 2)))
dev.off()
```

## Fraction comparison 

### Tumor / Non-tumor 

```{r}
fraction_my <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/04_broad/analysis_cat_PID.csv")

fraction_tu <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/tumor_panel/data_analysis/04_broad/analysis_cat_PID.csv")

fraction_T <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/04_broad/analysis_cat_PID_ccRCC_Tcell.csv")
```


```{r}
fraction_combined <- fraction_my %>% filter(analysis_cat == "tumor") %>% mutate(fra_my = fra) %>% select(PID, fra_my)

fraction_combined_1 <- fraction_T %>% filter(analysis_cat == "tumor") %>% mutate(fra_T = fra) %>% select(PID, fra_T)
fraction_combined_2 <- fraction_tu %>% filter(analysis_cat == "tumor") %>% mutate(fra_tu = fra) %>% select(PID, fra_tu)

fraction_combined$fra_T <- fraction_combined_1$fra_T[match(fraction_combined$PID, fraction_combined_1$PID)]
fraction_combined$fra_tu <- fraction_combined_2$fra_tu[match(fraction_combined$PID, fraction_combined_2$PID)]

fraction_combined <- fraction_combined %>% filter(complete.cases(.))
```

```{r}
# Read in sce for PID colors
sce <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_04.rds")
```

```{r}
# Cluster channel marker correlation (all markers - does not show distribution which is usually recommended)
cor_sce <- fraction_combined %>% select(fra_my, fra_T, fra_tu) %>% as.data.frame

corrplot(cor(cor_sce,method = "pearson"), method="color", col=brewer.pal(n=8, name="RdBu"),  
         type="upper", order="hclust",hclust.method = "ward.D2", 
         addCoef.col = "black", addCoefasPercent = F,# Add coefficient of correlation
         tl.col="black", tl.srt=40, #Text label color and rotation
         # Combine with significance
         #p.mat = , sig.level = 0.01, insig = "blank", 
         # hide correlation coefficient on the principal diagonal
         diag=F
)
```

```{r}
cor_test <- cor.test(x = fraction_combined$fra_my, fraction_combined$fra_tu, method = "pearson")

#cor_test <- cor.mtest(fraction_combined %>% select(fra_my, fra_T, fra_tu), method = "pearson")
cor_test

ggplot(fraction_combined, aes(x = fra_my, y = fra_tu))+  
  geom_point(aes(color = PID),size = 3)+
  geom_smooth(method='lm', formula= y~x, se = TRUE, color = "black")+
  scale_color_manual(values=metadata(sce)$colors$PID)+
  guides(color = "none")+
  ylab("Tumor fraction (T cell)")+
  xlab("Tumor fraction (Myeloid)")+
  theme_classic()+
  ggtitle(paste("Pearson = ",round(cor_test$estimate, digits = 2)))
```

### General immune cell types

```{r}
fraction_my <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/05_sub/immune_metacluster_PID.csv")
  
fraction_T <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/05_sub/immune_metacluster_PID_Tcell.csv")

fraction_tu <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/tumor_panel/data_analysis/06_immune/immune_metacluster_PID.csv")
```

#### Per celltype 

```{r}
# Select celltype
COI = "Endothelial"

fraction_combined <- fraction_my %>% filter(immune_metacluster == COI) %>% mutate(fra_my = fra) %>% select(PID, fra_my)

fraction_combined_1 <- fraction_T %>% filter(immune_metacluster == COI) %>% mutate(fra_T = fra) %>% select(PID, fra_T)
fraction_combined_2 <- fraction_tu %>% filter(immune_metacluster == COI) %>% mutate(fra_tu = fra) %>% select(PID, fra_tu)

fraction_combined$fra_T <- fraction_combined_1$fra_T[match(fraction_combined$PID, fraction_combined_1$PID)]
fraction_combined$fra_tu <- fraction_combined_2$fra_tu[match(fraction_combined$PID, fraction_combined_2$PID)]

fraction_combined <- fraction_combined %>% filter(complete.cases(.))
```

```{r}
# Cluster channel marker correlation (all markers - does not show distribution which is usually recommended)
cor_sce <- fraction_combined %>% select(fra_my, fra_T, fra_tu) %>% as.data.frame

corrplot(cor(cor_sce,method = "pearson"), method="color", col=brewer.pal(n=8, name="RdBu"),  
         type="upper", order="hclust",hclust.method = "ward.D2", 
         addCoef.col = "black", addCoefasPercent = F,# Add coefficient of correlation
         tl.col="black", tl.srt=40, #Text label color and rotation
         # Combine with significance
         #p.mat = , sig.level = 0.01, insig = "blank", 
         # hide correlation coefficient on the principal diagonal
         diag=F
)

cor_out <- cor(cor_sce,method = "pearson")
cor_out[cor_out !=1] %>% as.numeric() %>% unique()
```


```{r}
out_cor <- foreach(i = unique(fraction_my$immune_metacluster), .combine = "rbind")%do%{

fraction_combined <- fraction_my %>% filter(immune_metacluster == i) %>% mutate(fra_my = fra) %>% select(PID, fra_my)

fraction_combined_1 <- fraction_T %>% filter(immune_metacluster == i) %>% mutate(fra_T = fra) %>% select(PID, fra_T)
fraction_combined_2 <- fraction_tu %>% filter(immune_metacluster == i) %>% mutate(fra_tu = fra) %>% select(PID, fra_tu)

fraction_combined$fra_T <- fraction_combined_1$fra_T[match(fraction_combined$PID, fraction_combined_1$PID)]
fraction_combined$fra_tu <- fraction_combined_2$fra_tu[match(fraction_combined$PID, fraction_combined_2$PID)]

fraction_combined <- fraction_combined %>% filter(complete.cases(.))

cor_sce <- fraction_combined %>% select(fra_my, fra_T, fra_tu) %>% as.data.frame

cor_out <- cor(cor_sce,method = "pearson")
cor_out[cor_out !=1] %>% as.numeric() %>% unique()

data.frame(immune_metacluster = i, 
           cor = cor_out[cor_out !=1] %>% as.numeric() %>% unique(), 
           category = "celltype")
}
```

#### Per patient

```{r}
fraction_combined <- fraction_my %>% mutate(fra_my = fra) %>% select(PID, immune_metacluster, fra_my) %>% mutate(PID_mc = paste0(PID, "_",immune_metacluster))

fraction_combined_1 <- fraction_T %>% mutate(fra_T = fra) %>% select(PID, immune_metacluster, fra_T) %>% mutate(PID_mc = paste0(PID, "_",immune_metacluster))

fraction_combined_2 <- fraction_tu %>% mutate(fra_tu = fra) %>% select(PID, immune_metacluster, fra_tu) %>% mutate(PID_mc = paste0(PID, "_",immune_metacluster))

fraction_combined$fra_T <- fraction_combined_1$fra_T[match(fraction_combined$PID_mc, fraction_combined_1$PID_mc)]
fraction_combined$fra_tu <- fraction_combined_2$fra_tu[match(fraction_combined$PID_mc, fraction_combined_2$PID_mc)]

fraction_combined <- fraction_combined %>% filter(complete.cases(.))
```


```{r}
PID_cor <- foreach(i = unique(fraction_combined$PID), .combine = "rbind")%do%{
PID_out <- fraction_combined %>% filter(PID %in% i) %>% select(- PID, - immune_metacluster, - PID_mc)


cor_sce <- fraction_combined %>% select(fra_my, fra_T, fra_tu) %>% as.data.frame

cor_out <- cor(PID_out,method = "pearson")

data.frame(PID = i, 
           cor = cor_out[cor_out !=1] %>% as.numeric() %>% unique(), 
           category = "PID")


# cor <- cor.test(PID_out$fra_my, PID_out$fra_T, method = "pearson")
# data.frame(PID = i, cor = cor$estimate, category = "PID")
}

PID_cor_out <- PID_cor %>% group_by(PID) %>% summarize(cor_mean = mean(cor), category = "PID")
```

```{r}
ggplot(PID_cor_out, aes(x = category, y = cor_mean))+  
  geom_jitter(aes(color = PID), size = 3)+#position=position_jitter(w=0.1,h=0.1)
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = NA)+
  scale_color_manual(values=metadata(sce)$colors$PID)+
  guides(color = "none")+
  ylab("PCC")+
  xlab("Per PID")+
  theme_classic()+
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,1))+
  ggtitle(paste("Mean PCC = ",round(mean(PID_cor$cor), digits = 2)))
```
